name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ dev, dev-actions ]

jobs:
  build-test-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # If your Gitea cert is trusted in the runner image, you can remove this.
      - name: Configure Git SSL (temporary if using internal CA)
        run: |
          git config --global http.sslVerify false
          git config --global http."https://gitea.core.home.arpa/".sslVerify false

      - name: Verify Docker Environment (TLS Enabled)
        run: |
          set -x
          echo "DOCKER_HOST=${DOCKER_HOST}"
          echo "DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY=${DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY}"
          echo "DOCKER_CERT_PATH=${DOCKER_CERT_PATH}"
          # Check TLS certificates
          ls -la /certs/client/ || echo "TLS certs directory not found"
          ls -la /certs/client/{ca.pem,cert.pem,key.pem} || echo "TLS cert files not found"
          # Check Gitea CA cert
          ls -la /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/gitea-ca.crt || echo "Gitea CA cert not found"
          docker version
          docker info

      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build image
        run: docker build -t reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000/testrepo:latest .

      - name: Push image
        run: docker push reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000/testrepo:latest
